title: Koh Samet has its voices
kaylee: The whole Koh Samet trip talks now: 270 lines that played silent, recorded by the PR itself.
questions: In hide and seek, Daddy's “Eight!” is only a third of a second. Does it sound cut off?
The otter's “Sawasdee krap!”: does it sound right, or rude? (The transcriber heard something cheeky.)
Sparkle's beach names (Ao Hin Khok, Ao Prao, Ao Phai): close enough for Kaylee, or should I spell them the way they sound?
